gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
I can't figure ___ how this app works.
The police are cracking ___ on unlicensed street vendors.
gaps.explanation: 'Crack down on' = deal firmly with illegal behaviour.

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.
